name: Refinishing Walnut in Mercer Island Homes Without Losing the Color
title-tag: Refinishing Walnut Floors in Mercer Island, WA
meta-description: Sanding won’t strip walnut’s color — the finish decides. Toning sealers, why walnut lightens in lake light, and how we refinish Mercer Island walnut floors.
post-summary: March 3, 2027 · Walnut’s color runs through the board, so sanding exposes richer wood, not less of it — the finish is what makes or breaks the result. Why walnut lightens in Mercer Island’s lake-facing light, why we skip stain, and the sealer decision that keeps the depth.
